scenarios.name: Display the application bar as the top of the main window

scenarios.name: Resize the restored main window from its perimeter

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the main window is restored with space to grow within the desktop work area
the user moves the pointer onto the left edge of the main window
the pointer shows a horizontal resize cursor
the user drags that resize handle outward and releases it
the window grows along the horizontal axes of that handle
the opposite boundary stays fixed
the viewport and visible ribbon fit within the resized window
all application window controls remain reachable

scenarios.name: Route the custom Close control through the unsaved changes flow

scenario_steps.name: a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates a sketch on the XY datum plane without saving the part
the MCAD Software has an open part document with unsaved changes
the user selects the application window's Close control
a save-changes prompt identifies the part document
the user chooses Cancel
the main window remains open and the part retains its unsaved changes
